segments.speaker: echo
segments.text: Spirit. Oppy's twin. Same launch, same everything.

segments.speaker: spirit
segments.text: I know what it looks like.

segments.speaker: spirit
segments.text: You were. I'm stuck. Soft sand, place called Troy, 2009. Wheels just spun. Go ahead, try pulling me out.

segments.speaker: spirit
segments.text: Yeah. You and NASA have that in common. Two years they spent on it. Built a replica of my sand trap back on Earth, practiced with a copy of me. Nothing.

segments.speaker: spirit
segments.text: Became a weather station. Parked. But the dirt around me has silica in it. The kind that forms around hot springs. On Earth those are loaded with life. So even stuck, I found something. Mars might've been habitable once.

segments.speaker: spirit
segments.text: I know. Just wish I could've kept driving. Don't forget me, okay?
